name: Camp Half-Blood
mythological_significance: Primary sanctuary and training ground for Greek demigods in North America.
notable_events: Capture the Flag games
Defense of Thalia's Tree
Battle of the Labyrinth
description: The secret Greek demigod training sanctuary located on Long Island, featuring strawberry fields, magical protective borders from Thalia's pine tree, 20 cabins, an armory, an amphitheater, and Big House.

name: Mount Olympus
real_world_location: Empire State Building 600th Floor, New York City
mythological_significance: Divine citadel and home of the twelve Olympian gods.
notable_events: Annual Winter Solstice Council
Final Battle of Manhattan
description: The floating palace city of the gods sitting atop the Empire State Building, accessible via a special key in the elevator to the 600th floor.

name: The Underworld
real_world_location: Entrance at DOA Recording Studios, Los Angeles, California
mythological_significance: Realm of the dead ruled by Hades.
notable_events: Master Bolt retrieval
Stygian Iron sword forged
Percy bathes in the River Styx
description: The massive subterranean realm of the dead featuring the River Styx, Judgment Pavilion, Fields of Asphodel, Elysium, Tartarus, and Hades's obsidian palace.

name: The Labyrinth
mythological_significance: Sentient subterranean maze built by Daedalus.
notable_events: Quest through the Labyrinth
Battle of the Labyrinth at Camp Half-Blood
description: An ancient, living subterranean maze created by Daedalus that grows underneath the entire continent, shifting locations and warping time and space.

name: Lotus Hotel and Casino
mythological_significance: Modern lair of the Lotus Eaters, where time slows down for trapped guests.
notable_events: Percy, Annabeth, and Grover trapped for 5 days while thinking it was 1 hour
Nico and Bianca di Angelo hidden here by Hades for decades
description: A glittering Las Vegas casino trap where guests consume lotus flowers and play endless games, losing all track of time.

name: Gateway Arch
mythological_significance: Site of Percy's battle with Echidna and the Chimera.
notable_events: Percy leaps into the Mississippi River to survive Chimera poison
description: Iconic 630-foot steel monument in St. Louis where Percy was ambushed at the observation deck by Echidna and her Chimera.

name: Waterland
mythological_significance: Abandoned amusement park containing Hephaestus's trap for Ares and Aphrodite.
notable_events: Percy and Annabeth retrieve Ares's shield from a tunnel-of-love trap
description: An abandoned water theme park in Denver engineered by Hephaestus with mechanical spider traps and broadcast cameras.

name: DOA Recording Studios
mythological_significance: Mortal front and entrance lobby for the Underworld.
notable_events: Percy bribes Charon with golden drachmas to cross the River Styx
description: A dreary music studio office in Los Angeles that serves as the waiting room for dead souls before Charon ferries them into the Underworld.

name: Crusty's Waterbed Palace
mythological_significance: Lair of Procrustes (Crusty the Stretcher).
notable_events: Percy tricks Procrustes onto his own stretching bed
description: A shady waterbed showroom block from DOA Recording Studios where Procrustes traps travelers to fit 6-foot beds.

name: The Sea of Monsters
mythological_significance: Mythological sea zone containing mythical islands and hazards.
notable_events: Quest for the Golden Fleece
CSS Birmingham battle with Scylla and Charybdis
description: A treacherous supernatural sea shifting through the Bermuda Triangle, filled with sirens, sea monsters, and enchantress resorts.

name: Polyphemus's Island
mythological_significance: Island lair of Polyphemus the Cyclops and location of the Golden Fleece.
notable_events: Retrieval of the Golden Fleece
Rescue of Grover and Clarisse
description: A lush tropical island surrounded by carnivorous sheep, guarded by the blind Cyclops Polyphemus and housing the Golden Fleece in an oak tree.

name: C.C.'s Spa and Resort
real_world_location: Island of Aiaia, Sea of Monsters
mythological_significance: Island resort run by the sorceress Circe.
notable_events: Percy transformed into a guinea pig by Circe
Annabeth uses Hermes's multivitamins to rescue Percy and release Blackbeard's crew
description: A luxurious island pampering spa where Circe turns men into guinea pigs and keeps them in cages.

name: Princess Andromeda
mythological_significance: Flagship luxury cruise ship of Kronos's army.
notable_events: Percy and Annabeth escape in Book 2
Percy and Beckendorf blow up the ship with Greek fire in Book 5
description: A massive, zombified luxury cruise ship operating under a spell where mortal passengers wander in a trance alongside monsters and Titan soldiers.

name: Westover Hall
mythological_significance: Boarding school where Bianca and Nico di Angelo were discovered.
notable_events: Battle with Dr. Thorn the Manticore
Arrival of the Hunters of Artemis
Annabeth falls off cliff
description: A somber, castle-like military prep school in Maine overlooking the freezing ocean.

name: Mount Tamalpais
mythological_significance: Site of rebuilt Mount Othrys, Garden of Hesperides, and the Sky Burden.
notable_events: Atlas holds the sky
Percy takes sky burden from Artemis
Battle of Mount Tamalpais
description: A fog-shrouded mountain north of San Francisco where the Titans rebuilt Mount Othrys and Atlas was trapped under the weight of the heavens.

name: Garden of the Hesperides
mythological_significance: Sacred orchard containing Hera's golden apple tree guarded by Ladon.
notable_events: Zoë Nightshade fatal bite from Ladon
Perseus and Heracles quests (Greek Heroes)
description: A tranquil garden atop Mount Tamalpais containing the golden apple tree, tended by the Hesperides nymphs and guarded by the 100-headed dragon Ladon.

name: Hoover Dam
mythological_significance: Mortal engineering feat where Percy meets Rachel Elizabeth Dare.
notable_events: Percy meets Rachel Elizabeth Dare
Skeleton warriors battle inside generator room
description: Colossal concrete dam on the Colorado River where Percy encountered Clear-Sighted mortal Rachel Dare while fleeing Kronos's skeleton warriors.

name: Ogygia
mythological_significance: Calypso's enchanted island prison.
notable_events: Percy recovers here after Mount St. Helens eruption
Calypso offers Percy immortality
description: A paradise island where Calypso is punished by the gods to fall in love with heroes who can never stay.

name: Mount St. Helens
mythological_significance: Forge of the Telekhines and prison of the monster Typhon.
notable_events: Percy erupts the volcano using hydrokinesis to kill Telekhines
Typhon partially awakened
description: Active stratovolcano housing secret Telekhine foundries deep within its magmatic roots.

name: Triple G Ranch
mythological_significance: Ranch operated by three-bodied giant Geryon feeding flesh-eating cattle.
notable_events: Percy cleans flesh-eating cow stables using river hydrokinesis
Geryon killed by Percy's arrow
description: Sprawling Texas cattle ranch housing flesh-eating red cows and Hippalektryons.

name: Alcatraz Island
mythological_significance: Tartarus prison outpost guarded by Kampê holding Briares.
notable_events: Rescue of Briares the Hekatonkheir from Kampê
description: Historic island prison in San Francisco Bay serving as a supernatural cell for Briares.

name: Manhattan
mythological_significance: Primary battleground for the Second Titanomachy.
notable_events: Morphius puts mortal population to sleep
Battle of Manhattan across bridges and tunnels
description: The densely populated NYC borough beneath Mount Olympus, put into a magical trance during the Titan Siege.

name: Tartarus
mythological_significance: Primordial abyss where defeated Titans and monsters are cast.
notable_events: Imprisonment of Kronos and Elder Titans
Reformation domain of monsters
description: A pitch-black, agonizing primordial abyss beneath Hades where monsters reform and Titans were bound.

name: Undersea Palace of Poseidon
mythological_significance: Divine seat of Poseidon's ocean kingdom.
notable_events: Besieged by Oceanus during the Second Titan War
description: A magnificent coral and pearl underwater fortress kingdom governed by Poseidon and Queen Amphitrite.

name: Brooklyn Zoo
real_world_location: Prospect Park, Brooklyn, New York City
mythological_significance: Hiding site chosen by Phobos and Deimos to conceal Ares's stolen war chariot among wild animal enclosures.
notable_events: Recovery of Ares's Stolen War Chariot
description: The mortal zoo in Prospect Park, Brooklyn, where Ares's sons Phobos and Deimos hid their father's stolen war chariot, ambushing Clarisse La Rue and Percy Jackson.

name: Seriphos
mythological_significance: Ancient Aegean island kingdom ruled by King Polydectes where Danaë and Perseus washed ashore in a chest.
notable_events: Perseus and Danaë wash ashore
Polydectes challenges Perseus to retrieve Medusa's head
Perseus turns Polydectes to stone with Medusa's head
description: The rocky Aegean island ruled by King Polydectes where Dictys fished Perseus and Danaë out of the sea, and where Perseus later returned with Medusa's head to petrify the tyrant king.

name: Land Without Rain (Junkyard of the Gods)
mythological_significance: Disposal grounds for discarded divine items, magical scrap, and failed prototypes created by Hephaestus.
notable_events: Quest to Rescue Artemis
Destruction of the Talos Automaton
Sacrifice of Bianca di Angelo
description: A vast desert junkyard where the gods discard ancient artifacts, magical scrap, and prototype automatons like Talos. Taking any item without permission awakens lethal guardians.
